role_under_test.description: Terraform output name holding the ARN of the role `real` probes assume (bare output name, not a ${tf_output:...} placeholder)

simulate_artifacts.description: Artifact references that `simulate` probes evaluate as the PolicyInputList, relative to the scenario directory (e.g. policies/operator-policy.json, or ../b2-installer/policies/installer-policy.json for another live scenario's artifact). Omit to simulate all of scenario.yaml `artifacts`. Use it when a probes file targets one identity tier of a multi-tier scenario, or to exclude a non-simulatable resource/trust policy.

action.description: simulate: IAM action to simulate against the scenario's policy artifact(s) (iam:SimulateCustomPolicy)

params.description: real: operation kwargs (substitutions applied to string values)

save_output_as.description: real: stash a response field for later probes, e.g. agent_space_id=agentSpace.id

tolerate.description: real: error codes that also count as pass (idempotency)
